paragraphs: Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai.

In [Bava Metzia 85a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.85a.9-13) it is told that Rabbi happened upon the locale of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon (after his death) and asked whether a son remained of that righteous man. They told him: He has a son, but he does not conduct himself properly. He had him brought before him, invested him with the title Rabbi, and handed him over to Rabbi Shimon ben Yose ben Lakunya, his mother's brother. When he grew up he sat in Rabbi's academy, and when Rabbi heard his voice he said: This voice resembles the voice of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon. They told him: He is his son.[^1]

And when he died they wished to bring him into his father's cave but could not. A heavenly voice went out and said: Not because this one is greater than that one, but his father suffered the distress of the cave (when he fled with his father Rabbi Shimon), and this one (his son) did not suffer the distress of the cave. And in Tanchuma, Vayera-Lekh, the incident is transmitted mistakenly.[^2]

And in [Tosefta Kiddushin chapter 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kiddushin.1.9) we find Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Elazar saying in the name of Rabban Gamliel: Anyone who has a trade in hand is like a fenced vineyard. Hyman considers it likely that this is Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon, and that Rabban Gamliel is the son of Rabbi.[^3]

notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Rabbi gives Yose the title Rabbi. The man he entrusts him to is his maternal uncle, Shimon ben Isi ben Lakunya. Hyman gives ben Yose.
The linked Bavli also gives the heavenly voice’s explanation. The parallel Hyman cites as Tanchuma, Vayera-Lekh remains unconfirmed.

The linked Tosefta gives Yose בר״א saying this in Rabban Gamliel’s name. Hyman tentatively identifies Yose with the son of Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon, and takes Rabban Gamliel to be Rabbi’s son.
